decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The changelog line [ev-f387a976e3cf] is vague, but the linked PR (labelled breaking) gives the details: the servers load-balancer now uses the WRR balancer instead of the oxy one, and the healthcheck was rewritten to match [ev-b3a131bfe7e1]. The PR also states the effects concretely. Support for the old pre-2.5 sticky-cookie value is dropped, so active users' sticky sessions are discarded when upgrading from below 2.5. Services are now reused, so two routers that use the same service share load balancing [ev-b3a131bfe7e1][ev-b5ea13a6c4c6]. That is enough to write applicability (sticky cookies with the pre-2.5 cookie format, or a service shared by several routers) and consequence (sessions discarded, shared balancing), though the PR text is cut off after a note about the pipelining middleware.
